The '''Orcish Fletcher''' is a [[workshop]] used by [[Orc]]s to make powerful composite [[bow]]s and large batches of [[cv:arrow|Arrow]]s using [[wood]], [[cv:bone|bone]], [[metal]] and [[cv:gem|gem]]s.

==Menu==
'''Orcish Fletcher'''
*{{K|w}} Craft [[Wood]] Composite [[Bow]]
*{{K|b}} Craft [[cv:Bone|Bone]] Composite [[Bow]]
*{{K|i}} Craft [[Iron]] Composite [[Bow]]
*{{K|R}} Forge Batch (100) of [[Rusty iron]] [[cv:Arrow|Arrow]]s
*{{K|C}} Forge Batch (100) of [[Copper]] [[cv:Arrow|Arrow]]s
*{{K|O}} Forge Batch (100) of [[cv:Obsidian|Obsidian]] [[cv:Arrow|Arrow]]s
*{{K|I}} Forge Batch (100) of [[Iron]] [[cv:Arrow|Arrow]]s
*{{K|B}} Forge Batch (100) of [[Bronze]] [[cv:Arrow|Arrow]]s
*{{K|S}} Forge Batch (100) of [[Steel]] [[cv:Arrow|Arrow]]s
*{{K|G}} Craft [[cv:Gem|Gem]]tip [[cv:Arrow|Arrow]]s

==Common Uses==
*Making [[bow]]s and [[cv:arrow|arrow]]s for [[cv:hunting|hunting]] or your [[Military|Boworcs]].
